lines.text: Here's how Anthropic's sales team rebuilt inbound with an agent, in under sixty seconds.
Inbound means the people who contact sales first.
Say you fill in the Contact Sales form. A rep qualifies you, then passes you on, and you could wait days.
With tens of thousands of requests a month, the team couldn't keep up, yet most questions were simple, like what a plan costs.
So one engineer built a buying agent. It asks what you're trying to solve, then answers from the docs. It recommends a plan, sometimes the Team plan instead of Enterprise.
Every conversation ends one of three ways. You can buy at checkout, get a quick answer, or be handed to a person, with the full conversation and the reason it escalated.
Those hand-offs become real sales opportunities more than twice as often as the old form's leads, and they close about five days faster.
